White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt to Depart

White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt will leave her position at the end of the month, as announced by President Donald Trump. Leavitt, 28, was the youngest person to hold the role. She had recently returned to the White House after a leave for the birth of her second child in May. Some coverage noted her tenure as the president's mouthpiece and highlighted memorable moments from her time in the role.
